text:
Which statement about acids is correct?
A
A strong acid has a higher pH than a weak acid of the same concentration.
B
A strong acid is a proton acceptor.
C
A weak acid is a proton donor.
D
A weak acid is fully ionised in aqueous solution.

options.label: A
options.text: A strong acid has a higher pH than a weak acid of the same concentration.

options.label: B
options.text: A strong acid is a proton acceptor.

options.label: C
options.text: A weak acid is a proton donor.

options.label: D
options.text: A weak acid is fully ionised in aqueous solution.
